content: For individuals with type 2 diabetes who are able to achieve and maintain a weight loss of 10% or more, the benefits are particularly significant. Such a degree of weight reduction is strongly associated with marked improvements in cardiovascular risk factors, including reductions in blood pressure and enhancements in lipid profiles. Additionally, this level of weight loss may decrease the risk of long-term complications associated with type 2 diabetes, such as cardiovascular disease. It can also lead to improvements in overall quality of life and physical functioning. These findings emphasize the importance of establishing realistic and achievable weight loss goals as an integral component of diabetes management and care.
